entry.title: I volunteered at the 2026 FIFA World Cup! :soccer:

link.title: I volunteered at the 2026 FIFA World Cup! :soccer:

entry.content:
I had the incredible opportunity to volunteer at the 2026 FIFA World Cup, working in both Catering and Fan Operations.

Over the course of the tournament, I volunteered at five matches:

  • June 18: South Africa vs. Czech Republic
  • June 21: Spain vs. Saudi Arabia
  • July 1: England vs. DR Congo
  • July 7: Argentina vs. Egypt
  • July 15: Argentina vs. England — Semifinal

Experiencing the World Cup from behind the scenes was completely different from watching it as a fan. From helping with stadium operations to seeing supporters from around the world come together, it was one of the most memorable experiences of my time in the US. :soccer:
entry.summary: Five matches, two roles, and one unforgettable World Cup experience!

entry.title: I completed ALL achievements in Balatro :clown_face: :black_joker:, including earning a Gold Sticker on every Joker (Completionist++)!

link.title: I completed ALL achievements in Balatro :clown_face: :black_joker:, including earning a Gold Sticker on every Joker (Completionist++)!

entry.content:
After way too many hours, countless runs, and an unreasonable amount of attachment to virtual Jokers, I finally earned Completionist++ — a Gold Sticker on every Joker in the game.

Was it worth it? Absolutely. Would I recommend doing it? Probably not. :black_joker:
entry.summary: Fewer than 0.1% of all players have done this. Massive!

entry.title: For the second time in my life, I witnessed a total solar eclipse! 🌒

link.title: For the second time in my life, I witnessed a total solar eclipse! 🌒

entry.content:
What are the odds of seeing two total solar eclipses in one lifetime?

Even more remarkably, the first one happened on the very first day I arrived in the United States. Seven years later, I was lucky enough to experience totality again. There is something surreal about watching the sky suddenly go dark in the middle of the day — definitely something photos can never fully capture.
entry.summary: The first time was on my very first day in the US - guess when and where!
